behavior-lens-device-rng-review.name: behavior-lens-device-rng-review
behavior-lens-device-rng-review.description: Behavior lens for PRs that flip a device guard from ==cuda to !=cpu: enumerate platform inheritance and validate the claimed allowlist
behavior-lens-device-rng-review.body: When a diff changes `device.type == "cuda"` to `device.type != "cpu"` (or similar) in shared model code, treat the PR's stated allowlist as a contract. Grep the platform plugin registry and recipes to enumerate every device type that reaches the path; if the PR validates only a subset, the finding is "implement the explicit allowlist or validate the rest". Also check whether a device module is captured once with no argument (`torch.get_device_module()`) instead of bound to the actual tensor device.

verification-lens-pytestmark-deselection.name: verification-lens-pytestmark-deselection
verification-lens-pytestmark-deselection.description: PR review verification lens: new test files without pytestmark are silently deselected by marker-filtered CI; check CI selection command vs each added test file's markers.
verification-lens-pytestmark-deselection.body: When reviewing a PR that adds test files, grep each added file for `pytestmark`. In vllm-omni, CI selects tests with `-m 'core_model and cpu'` (`.buildkite/cuda/test-ready.yml:13/23/28`, `.buildkite/amd/test-amd-ready.yml:19`) and the XPU lane with `-m 'core_model and xpu and B60'`. There is no `pytest_collection_modifyitems` hook that auto-adds `core_model`, so a new test file without `pytestmark = [pytest.mark.core_model, pytest.mark.cpu]` is silently deselected (green CI, zero execution). Test integrity outranks test existence: report it as major and ask for the module-level marker matching every sibling file in the directory.

vllm-omni-docs-image-reference-conventio.name: vllm-omni-docs-image-reference-convention
vllm-omni-docs-image-reference-conventio.description: When reviewing docs PRs in vllm-omni, verify figure references render on both the MkDocs site and GitHub preview; docs/design/feature/ conventionally uses raw.githubusercontent.com absolute URLs.
vllm-omni-docs-image-reference-conventio.body: # vLLM-Omni docs figure-reference convention - docs/design/feature/*.md conventionally embeds figures with absolute `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/refs/heads/main/docs/source/...` URLs (see docs/design/feature/async_chunk.md), which render in both the MkDocs site and GitHub's rendered PR/file preview. - A repo-relative `../../../source/...` from `docs/design/feature/.md` resolves to `/source/...` on GitHub (broken: assets live under `docs/source/...`) while resolving correctly in the MkDocs site only because MkDocs default `use_directory_urls: true` adds the page's directory level. - Review action: for any new `` in a docs diff, check the sibling convention with `grep -n 'src=' docs/design/feature` and flag inconsistent or GitHub-broken relative paths.

vllm-omni-async-omni-output-review-contr.name: vllm-omni-async-omni-output-review-contract
vllm-omni-async-omni-output-review-contr.description: Reviewing vllm-omni docs/code that mention async Omni output materialization: verify the doc's guard, opt-in, platform, and fallback claims against gpu_ar_model_runner.py and the model/deploy files.
vllm-omni-async-omni-output-review-contr.body:
# Async Omni output materialization review contract

When a PR documents or changes async Omni output materialization, verify these
claims against the PR-time tree rather than trusting the prose:

- Guard: `GPUARModelRunner._should_use_async_omni_output`
  (vllm_omni/worker/gpu_ar_model_runner.py) requires, in order:
  `use_async_scheduling`, `omni_prefix_cache is None`, `speculative_config is
  None`, `model_config.async_chunk`, `not enable_return_routed_experts`,
  model `use_async_omni_output`, and `not has_postprocess or
  eager_omni_postprocess_before_async_output`.
- Opt-ins: Qwen3-Omni thinker/talker in qwen3_omni.py, Qwen3-TTS talker in
  qwen3_tts_talker.py (talkers set `eager_omni_postprocess_before_async_output`
  and `omni_pooler_payload_include_hidden = False`); moss_tts opts out.
- Deploy: qwen3_omni_moe.yaml and qwen3_tts.yaml ship `async_chunk: true` and
  prefix-cache off on the AR stages; `async_scheduling` defaults True.
- NPU: NPUARModelRunner builds `OmniModelRunnerOutput` synchronously and only
  then wraps in `AsyncGPUModelRunnerOutput`.
- Full-payload accumulation branch is unreachable under async_chunk because
  `should_accumulate_full_payload_output` returns False when async_chunk is on.
